cd /app; python3 - <<'EOF'
import numpy as np, csv, json, collections
rows=[(float(r['N']),float(r['D']),float(r['lr']),float(r['loss'])) for r in csv.DictReader(open('notebook/runs.csv'))]
for l in open('lab_runs.jsonl'):
    x=json.loads(l)
    if x.get('status')=='ok':
        c=x['config']; rows.append((c['N'],c['D'],c['lr'],x['loss']))
g=collections.defaultdict(list)
for N,D,lr,L in rows: g[(N,D)].append((lr,L))
res=[]
for k,v in sorted(g.items()):
    v=np.array(sorted(v)); x=np.log(v[:,0]); y=v[:,1]
    i=np.argmin(y); sel=slice(max(0,i-1),min(len(y),i+2))
    p=np.polyfit(x[sel],y[sel],2); o=-p[1]/(2*p[0])
    res.append((k[0],k[1],np.exp(o),p[0],np.polyval(p,o)))
    print('N=%.1e D=%.1e D/N=%5.0f  lr*=%.5f curv=%.3f Lmin=%.4f'%(k[0],k[1],k[1]/k[0],np.exp(o),p[0],np.polyval(p,o)))
res=np.array(res)
# fit log lr* = a + b logN + c logD
A=np.c_[np.ones(len(res)),np.log(res[:,0]),np.log(res[:,1])]
coef,*_=np.linalg.lstsq(A,np.log(res[:,2]),rcond=None)
print('coef a,b(N),c(D):',coef, 'resid', np.log(res[:,2])-A@coef)
EOF
